messages:
lex: Heads up — after the DST shift this morning we're seeing duplicate interviewer availability slots in the scheduler and candidates are getting two invites for the same panel. Noticed it for 3 interviews this morning already.

maria: Ugh, saw that too. Which scheduler are we talking about? ATS calendar sync or our internal scheduler service?

lex: Looks like the internal scheduler emits two events when local timezone offset changes on the interviewer profile. It then calls the ATS webhook twice. Example log from the scheduler: 
```
2026-03-23T08:14:02Z INFO schedule: created invite interviewer_id=U123 shift=UTC+1
2026-03-23T08:14:02Z INFO schedule: created invite interviewer_id=U123 shift=UTC+1
```

samir: Interesting — I can reproduce locally by toggling the timezone on a mock profile. The debounce logic uses epoch day instead of offset, so multiple events get through. I'll patch the event dedupe by adding a deterministic event id.

jess: Meanwhile can Talent Ops cancel the duplicate invites so candidates don't get confused? I can also add a quick note in the interview confirmation email.

maria: @talent-ops-bot can you scope which candidates got doubles in the last 6 hours and cancel dupe invites? Also please surface any affected scheduled panels for the next 48h.

talent-ops-bot: Scanning... found 7 candidate invites with duplicate calendar events across 4 panels. Generated cancel list and started cancellations for events created less than 1h ago. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/dup-invites/1912345678

lex: Thanks — Samir, ETA on the dedupe patch? If it's quick we can patch prod and avoid more churn.

samir: I have a patch ready. Deploying to staging now, running scheduler integration test suite. If green I'll roll to prod in ~20–30m with a short maintenance window. Will add a migration to re-hash existing pending events.

jess: I'll ping CS and interview coordinators to expect ~30m maintenance and to hold off manual resends until we confirm.

maria: Postmortem action items: 1) fix event dedupe, 2) add regression test for DST toggle, 3) add alert when >3 duplicate invites created in 1h, 4) run one-off cleanup for last 72h. I'll create a tracking ticket after this thread.

lex: Awesome — appreciate the quick triage. @samir please drop the prod rollback plan in the ticket in case we need it. :thumbsup:
